📋 Court House Rules
🕐 Booking & Court Time
  • Operating Hours: Open daily from 5:00 AM to 2:00 AM the next day. Please pack up promptly at the end of your session.
  • Strictly by Reservation: All players must book their slots in advance through this website.
  • Be on Time: Your booking period is fixed. No extensions will be given for late arrivals.
  • Strict Cancellation & Refund Policy: All bookings are final. No cancellations and no refunds are allowed.
  • Weather-Permitting Policy (Open Court only): If it rains during your Open Court (no roof) session, you may reschedule to another available date/time — no refunds, rescheduling only.
👟 Attire & Equipment
  • Proper Footwear Only: Non-marking sports shoes. Slippers, sandals, and leather shoes are strictly prohibited.
  • Proper Sports Apparel: Please wear appropriate athletic clothing.
  • Bring Your Own Gear: Please bring your own paddles and balls. Rentals are coming soon.
🤝 Etiquette, Cleanliness & Liability
  • Wait for a rally to finish before walking behind or crossing an active court.
  • Only water or sports drinks in spill-proof bottles allowed courtside. No food inside the playing area.
  • CLAYGO — Clean As You Go. Use the trash bins provided.
  • 100% smoke-free and vape-free facility.
  • Players are responsible for damage caused by negligence. Management is not responsible for lost or stolen items.
❓ Frequently Asked Questions
What are your operating hours?

Open daily 5:00 AM – 2:00 AM. Closed for maintenance 2:00 AM – 5:00 AM.

Do you have indoor or outdoor courts?

We have two courts: Court 1 (Covered, with roof) and Court 2 (Open, no roof), both with sports LED lighting.

What is your cancellation and refund policy?

Strict No Cancellation, No Refund policy. If it rains during your Open Court booking, you may reschedule (no refunds).

Can we rent paddles and balls?

Not yet available — coming soon! Please bring your own paddles and balls for now.

How do I book a court?

Select your date, tap a slot, choose your duration (1–3 hrs), fill in your details, then proceed to payment (GCash or Bank Transfer).

Bookings are visible to everyone in real time 🏓 No refunds or changes once a slot is booked — please book only when you're sure.
